10. C Shamshuddin, Junior Assistant (In-charge Sub-Registrar)
Banaganapalle Nandyal District  ...Respondents

Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased to pleased to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of Mandamus to declare the delay and inaction on the part of respondent No.1 in considering and disposing of the complaint dt.01-12-2022 submitted by the petitioner in terms of Sec.154 of Cr.P.C. as arbitrary, illegal and contrary to Sec.154 of Cr.P.C. and consequently direct the respondent No.1 to consider and dispose of the complaint dt.01-12-2022 submitted by the petitioner accordance with Sec.154 of Cr.P.C. in the interest of justice.
IA NO: 1 OF 2023  Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased pleased to direct the respondent No.1 to consider and dispose of the complaint dt.01-12-2022 submitted by the petitioner accordance with Sec.154 of Cr.P.C. pending disposal of the writ petition in the interest of justice Counsel for the Petitioner: P NAGENDRA REDDY Counsel for the Respondents: GP FOR HOME The Court made the following order:
 THE HONOURABLE DR JUSTICE VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA  WRIT PETITION NO: 3386 OF 2023 ORDER:
This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India with the following prayer for:
"... pleased to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of Mandamus to declare the delay and inaction on the part of respondent No.1 in considering and disposing of the complaint dt.01-12-2022 submitted by the petitioner in terms of Sec.154 of Cr.P.C. as arbitrary, illegal and contrary to Sec.154 of Cr.P.C. and consequently direct the respondent No.1 to consider and dispose of the complaint dt.01- 12-2022 submitted by the petitioner accordance with Sec.154 of Cr.P.C. in the interest of justice. ....."

2. Heard Sri P.Nagendra Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri V.Farook, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home.
3.

When the matter is taken up for hearing, Sri V.Farooq, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home for the respondents, on written instructions, brought to the notice of this Court basing on the complaint of the petitioner dated 11.02.2023, a crime was registered in Cr.No.41 of 2023 under Syed Abbas Ali vs The Station House Officer on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94656889/
2 Sections 406, 420 r/w 34 Ipc on the file of Banganapalli, Nandyal against accused Nos.1 to 7.
4.

sentences.text: Learned Assistant Government Pleader would submit that the Court may pass appropriate orders.
5. Recording the same, the writ petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
